prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1200; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound through the signalized intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding westbound and entered the intersection as the signal changed. The point of impact and the resulting intrusion into the driver's door are consistent with a side collision at the speed reported by both drivers. Driver 1 was the operator of the vehicle, and a Passenger was seated in the front right position. Officers on scene confirmed Driver 1's presence in the vehicle at the time of impact, and this was also confirmed by two independent witnesses who observed the collision from the adjacent corner. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side panels and door that corresponds with the force of the impact described by all parties. Driver 2 acknowledged entering the intersection and did not dispute the sequence of events. No prior damage to the vehicle was noted in the records reviewed or reported by either party. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back shortly after the collision and was transported for evaluation. The reported symptoms are consistent with the mechanism of injury observed at the scene.
